entries.name: International Veterinary Hospital
entries.note: IPATA member page gives phone and website only. Own website ivhq8.com was refused by WebFetch (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED), not opened; hours and 24 h status unverified.

notes: Very thin run. No official body page (PAAAFR, Kuwait Veterinary Association/Society, Kuwait University) was reachable or usable: paaafr.gov.kw was refused by WebFetch (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED) and searches surfaced no vet directory or duty rota there. Royal Animal Hospital site (rahkwt.com) redirect-looped and could not be opened. ivhq8.com refused. No duty rotas and no animal poison lines found for Kuwait. Candidate 24 h clinics seen only on aggregators and therefore not published: Safari Vet Clinic (Shuwaikh Industrial, +965 66617444, PawApp 'Open 24/7') and Kuwait Animal Hospital (Expat Focus 'open 24 hours a day'); other named clinics: Royal Animal Hospital (+965 24750966), Dohamma/Al Dohama Vet Hospital (+965 2472-2002), Fahaheel Veterinary Clinic, Al Rai Veterinary Clinic. Needs own-site verification in a later run.
